fields.label: Organization Code
fields.description: Short code unik untuk inventory organization. Minimal Create IO wajib diisi.

fields.label: Organization Name
fields.description: Nama inventory organization. Minimal Create IO wajib diisi.

fields.label: Management Business Unit ID
fields.description: ID Management Business Unit. Minimal Create IO wajib diisi. Ambil dari Reference Finder: Business Units.

fields.label: Legal Entity ID
fields.description: ID Legal Entity. Minimal Create IO wajib diisi. Ambil dari Reference Finder: Legal Entities.

fields.label: Profit Center Business Unit ID
fields.description: ID Profit Center Business Unit. Minimal Create IO wajib diisi. Pada beberapa setup nilainya bisa sama dengan ManagementBusinessUnitId, tetapi tetap cek reference/setting instance.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Status organization. Minimal Create IO wajib diisi. Umumnya Active.

fields.label: Location ID
fields.description: ID lokasi inventory organization. Minimal Create IO wajib diisi. Ambil dari Reference Finder: Locations LOV atau existing IO reference.
fields.reference_hint: Reference Finder: Locations LOV / existing IO

fields.label: Inventory Flag
fields.description: Minimal Create IO wajib diisi. true = inventory organization.

fields.label: Item Master Organization ID
fields.description: ID Item Master / Master Inventory Organization. Minimal Create IO wajib diisi. Ambil dari Reference Finder: Inventory Organizations LOV.

fields.label: Item Grouping Behavior
fields.description: Minimal Create IO wajib diisi. Gunakan ORA_RCS_IGB_DFTN untuk Definition Organization atau ORA_RCS_IGB_RFRC untuk Reference Organization.

fields.label: Item Definition Organization Code
fields.description: Minimal Create IO wajib diisi untuk mode Definition Organization. Isi sama dengan OrganizationCode. Jika kosong dan ItemGroupingCode = ORA_RCS_IGB_DFTN, app akan otomatis mengisi dari OrganizationCode saat membangun payload.
fields.reference_hint: Untuk ORA_RCS_IGB_DFTN: isi sama dengan OrganizationCode

fields.label: Schedule ID
fields.description: Schedule ID. Minimal Create IO wajib diisi. Ambil dari Reference Finder: Schedules atau dari existing IO reference.
